chunks: We were told by my father, may Allah grant him mercy, that he said: We were told by Ali bin Ibrahim bin Hashim, from his father, from Hussain bin Yazid al-Nawfali, from Ali bin Dawud al-Ya’qoubi, from Isa bin Abduullah bin Muhammed bin Umar bin Ali bin Abi Talib, from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali bin Abi Talib, peace be upon him, that he said: The Messenger of Allah, Allah’s blessings be upon him and his Family:

O Allah, have mercy upon my successors. O Allah, have mercy upon my successors. O Allah, have mercy upon my successors. It was said to him: O Messenger of Allah, and who are your successors? He said: Those who will come after me, narrate my narration and my tradition.
ai.seo_question: Who are the successors of the Prophet Muhammad according to this hadith?
ai.summary: In this narration from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Ma'ani al-Akhbar*, the Prophet identifies his successors not merely as political leaders but as the scholars and tradition bearers who preserve and transmit his Sunnah, a concept central to Shia epistemology. This definition elevates the role of the *ahl al-hadith* as the living custodians of prophetic authority after the Prophet's departure, ensuring the continuity of divine guidance through authentic narration. It underscores the Shia view that religious authority and preservation of the message are vested in those who faithfully carry the prophetic tradition.
